en.title: NPIO Regulations Schedule 1: "Authorised Activities" defined by s.8, which is the prohibition; the definition is in s.9
en.summary: The definition reads "section 8 (Authorised Activities of Incorporated Organisations)". s.8 is "Prohibition against conducting certain activities". s.9 is "Authorised Activities of Incorporated Organisations", and s.9(2) lists them. The heading in brackets saves the meaning. The NPIO Rules fine table correctly cites "9(1) Authorised Activities".
en.correction: Please replace "section 8" with "section 9" in the definition of Authorised Activities.
